scope: Agent-assisted editing recipe; not an installed desktop renderer preset

limits: Motion observations cover only the sampled windows; numeric defaults below are adaptation choices, not measured source values

output_defaults.length: Preserve the complete coherent source message; do not impose reference duration
output_defaults.render_policy: Render DOM/SVG/text natively at output size; design coordinates scale uniformly. Do not represent upscaled source footage as recovered detail.

layout_defaults.coordinate_system: production_layout.design_canvas coordinates, top-left origin; scale both axes uniformly to output_defaults
layout_defaults.fit: Reframe the new presenter footage to fit; never stretch source. Supporting asset and caption boxes retain approved design coordinates.

observed: Separate white paper number and instruction labels
Caption phrase grows across some sampled words then resets
Labels and logos swap without persistent wobble
White number appears before yellow title
Brief partially transparent title visible in sampled transition
Title persists while lower single words change
Small white handwritten annotations and occasional icons
No large screenshot covering the face in sampled full overview

caption.korean_units: 1-3 eojeol per cue, combine if too fast to read; do not split syllables

assets.idle: Remove main title when numbered section ends

shared_edit_rules.cut: Audio-first directory rule: resolve an already tail-edited audio master, preserve its order, gaps, duration and speed. No automatic silence/filler/retake removal. Overlay visuals and captions on its unchanged timeline.
shared_edit_rules.timestamps: Keep source-to-output mapping after each cut; captions and assets use output timeline
shared_edit_rules.title_hold: Upper summary/organizing guide may span several spoken sentences and SRT cues; do not mirror each short utterance. Shared keywords or CTA are allowed when communicative roles differ.
shared_edit_rules.asset_sync: Anchor to spoken referent or action; no random timed cycling
shared_edit_rules.copyright: Study layout; do not copy reference creator footage, voice or their extracted meme assets into user deliverables
shared_edit_rules.audio: Lock verified tail-edited master audio; remux unchanged where possible and compare actual audio hashes and duration. Reference audio identity is unverified.
shared_edit_rules.korean_copy: Humanize only newly authored headings/annotations; faithfully transcribed speech is not paraphrased for style
shared_edit_rules.review: Check actual full-resolution frames, transitions, first/last syllables, and audio before completion
shared_edit_rules.caption_contract: Lower text is verbatim speech aligned to locked tail-edited master; export SRT and burned captions from one cues source. No editorial summarization of speech.

runtime_status: Recipe configured; future raw-source end-to-end render requires supplied source and local render/transcription checks

supporting_asset_contract.upper_role: Explain spoken content with supplementary copy, examples, relevant images, diagrams or step guides. Summary titles are one option, not mandatory on every beat.
supporting_asset_contract.lower_role: Time-synchronized verbatim speech captions from locked audio master.
avoid: Presenting illustrative mockups as actual work or proof
supporting_asset_contract.provenance_storage: Keep source, license and illustrative status in internal edit plan; omit visible source/illustrative badges per user instruction.
supporting_asset_contract.preferred_media: Newly authored transcript-specific motion graphics and After Effects-style mask reveals, tracked callouts, shape/type motion and before/after animations. Fresh capture ingredients only when explaining a real interface requires them.
rejected_treatments: Fictional dashboard rectangles when real sources exist
Static process diagrams as primary media
Large single card combining heading subheading and diagram
Long unchanged panels used instead of reference internal asset phases
supporting_asset_contract.asset_production: User explicitly requests separately producing assets. Build editable functioning web/app/worksheet demonstrations and record actual interactions, rather than stopping at asset search. Retain real source content as grounding.
supporting_asset_contract.authored_demo_provenance: Newly authored visual prototypes are allowed; record their provenance internally, do not claim deployed services or real student outcomes, and omit on-screen production/source labels.
supporting_asset_contract.no_repeated_video: Each supporting video file is used once per finished video. Renaming, re-encoding, cropping or recoloring the same recording does not count as a new asset. Revisit a subject only with a newly recorded distinct screen, task state and explanatory action; verify resolved paths, file hashes and sampled visual content. Presenter and locked voice tracks are exempt.
supporting_asset_contract.priority: For every new video, read its actual subtitle transcript and author fresh explanatory visuals/motion graphics from scratch. Reuse tools/layout/fonts, not previous-video artwork, copy, recordings or finished compositions.
supporting_asset_contract.freshness: Every supporting asset records created_for_job, authored_source, caption evidence and explanatory purpose. Metadata and unique hashes do not replace visual/source review.
supporting_asset_contract.after_effects: Effect vocabulary, not a claim of Adobe After Effects execution or .aep output. Default implementation uses render-safe HyperFrames/GSAP/SVG/CSS; use actual AE only when explicitly requested and available.

paper_copy_contract.font_candidate: EastSeaDokdo; adaptation only, not identified reference font
paper_copy_contract.shape: Separate phrase/word off-white paper fragments, compact padding, mildly rough edges, slight independent rotations
paper_copy_contract.hierarchy: Short hook/action/warning/CTA; 1-3 lines with mixed sizes; no full transcription duplication
paper_copy_contract.timing: Reference sampled number-to-label delay .367-.500s; adapt to actual speech. Other asset changes tied to clauses, not fixed arbitrary cadence.

presenter.reframe: inspect and override picture framing per input; keep overlay geometry fixed

production_layout.basis: Approved V4aligned geometry with user-requested V6 black caption shadow. Pixel sizes are design coordinates; 4K scale is2.
